## Important Notice

Do not use this template for public disclosure of security vulnerabilities.

For confidential reporting, email security@signalforge.ai directly.

If you are filing this through GitHub, note that the repository maintainers will handle this report privately. Do not include full exploit code in this issue.

## Severity Assessment

- [ ] Critical - Full system compromise, data breach, or financial loss
- [ ] High - Significant data exposure or privilege escalation
- [ ] Medium - Limited data exposure or privilege escalation
